claims.note: Source: "Lippi was born in Florence in 1406 to Tommaso, a butcher"

claims.claim: orphaned at two; convent at eight
claims.note: Source: "He was orphaned when he was two years old"
Source: "He was ordained as a priest in approximately 1425"
Source: "In 1432, Filippo Lippi quit the monastery, although he was not released"

claims.claim: Prato 1458, Lucrezia Buti, boarder or novice
claims.note: Source: "Lucrezia Buti, a beautiful boarder or novice of the Order"
Source: "their son Filippino Lippi in 1457, who became a famous painter"
Source: "Lippi died in Spoleto, on or about 8 October 1469"
Source: "many said that the spirit of Masaccio had entered into Fra Filippo"
Source: "his paintings had become popular, warranting the support of the Medici family"
Source: "Sandro Botticelli and Francesco di Pesello (called Pesellino) were among"
Source: "The close of Lippi's life was spent at Spoleto"

claims.claim: Cosimo imprisoned him; rope of sheets
claims.note: Source: "the painter escaped by a rope made of his sheets"
Source: "celebrated in Robert Browning's poem "Fra Lippo Lippi" (1855)"
Source: "Lucrezia is thought to be the model for many of Filippo Lippi's"
Source: "he describes himself as the poorest friar of Florence"
Source: "The mode of his death is a matter of dispute"
